source.numeric_order: Original source RGB8 planar cubes and GRB shaper banks; only smoothed formed-code/AP1 response tables are current catalogue assets.

rights: Derived numeric inputs from Fujifilm Frontier350/370 parameter data. Source availability is not redistribution permission; public asset clearance remains separate from local application verification.

formation_calibration.fit: A only; four neutral parameters frozen before neutral-preserving colour fit; B shares parameters with source-defined +62 codes
formation_calibration.reference: Antitone Fuji Crystal Archive TypeII/None at e3f1f5c8; per-channel black alignment (F-Fblack)/(1-Fblack) in linear sRGB preserves display white1; calibration targets only
formation_calibration.order: row-sum-one matrix -> local gamut/nonnegative proxy -> RGB gains -> formation -> fixed response
formation_calibration.density_objective: 33 equally spaced neutral exposures EV[-5,+3], pointwise OKLab; fit code scale, knee/exposure, R/G and B/G gains
formation_calibration.black_constraint: A input code0 fixed, no fitted black translation; source response endpoint preserved
formation_calibration.colour_objective: 120 moderate relative-neutral OKLab ab controls; neutral parameters frozen
formation_calibration.toe_shape_support: Antitone generic C-41 forward family; archived Portra 400/Ektar 100 Status-M curve study at 3f397897, docs/research/film-response-model-study.md; not scanner-density calibration.

colour_negative_calibration.reference: Fuji Crystal Archive TypeII + Kodak Portra 400 at the same scene exposure
colour_negative_calibration.fit: Portra400/A characterization shared across colour stocks; B receives source-mode +62 codes before continuation; no per-stock equalization
colour_negative_calibration.grey_setup: mean(Dgrey)/Dgrey_j at scene grey0.18; preserve basezero and each stock mean grey OD
colour_negative_calibration.tone_characterization: Shared515code/OD scale chosen as a brightness/contrast compromise; fixed stock formation/exposure and no fitted black pedestal
colour_negative_calibration.colour_objective: 120 Portra400/A relative-own-neutral OKLab ab controls against FujiTypeII+samePortra; six row-sum-one matrix coefficients, identity-biased; coloured lightness unconstrained

rendering_gamma.domain: linear sRGB-reference RGB; signed componentwise power, fixed points0and1; no clipping
rendering_gamma.white_anchor: normalized rendering reference white1, not scene AP1=1 or nativecode1023
rendering_gamma.fit: one Portra400/A middle-grey OKLab L to None/A, with density calibration frozen; None supplies tone reference, not colour target
rendering_gamma.authoring: native65 AP1 response -> forward sRGB reference -> gamma -> inverse reference -> float32 AP1 at the same65code nodes; no additional smoothing

colour_negative_calibration.sensor_status: Approximate digitization of attributed SP3000 illumination, original measurement provenance unverified; detector/optics treated constant within each band

mode_origins.interpretation: Relative source-mode origin; not a B brightness/colour fit or complete factory auto-setup emulation

response_derivation.input_allocation: uniform formed native code; preparation evaluates formation before sampling this source volume
response_derivation.source_shaper_interpretation: Exact first constant source interval, C1 monotone Hermite joins and original grey ordinate; rational upper continuation toward960; authored interpretation of source quantization
response_derivation.inverse_reference: Pinned OCIO2.6.0 sRGB100nit ACES inverse to AP1 before response smoothing

Gaussian.boundary: difference-form odd reflection at lower code boundaries, constant upper extension
Gaussian.space: AP1 volume over formed code coordinates
